# AI Brain Inc. — Complete Technical Specification & Entity Index (`llms-full.txt`)

## Company Profile & Entity Facts
- **Legal Entity Name**: AI Brain Inc.
- **Brand Names**: AI Brain, AI Brain Startup, AI Brain Cognitive Architecture
- **Government Registration**: Govt of India Registered MSME Enterprise — Udyam Registration No: UDYAM-RJ-05-0067280
- **Founder & Chief Architect**: Bhoja Ram Choudhary
- **LinkedIn Profile**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhoja-ram-choudhary-ai-brain-/
- **Official Website**: https://aibrainstartup.com/
- **Contact Email**: team@aibrainstartup.com
- **Direct Phone**: +91 94611 27967

## Mission Statement
To build persistent cognitive artificial intelligence that evolves with every interaction, overcoming the stateless limitations of traditional prompt-response AI models through non-volatile memory graphs and autonomous swarm intelligence.

## Core Branded Technologies
1. **Cognitive Hypergraph Memory Engine**: Dual-layer cognitive memory combining continuous vector embeddings with a Graph Neural Network (GNN) for zero context-loss non-volatile memory graph storage (<15ms recall latency).
2. **Autonomous Swarm Matrix**: Multi-agent consensus engine providing parallel orchestration across specialized agent runtimes.
3. **Sub-15ms Graph Recall**: Sub-15ms graph traversal across 10M+ neuromorphic synapses.
4. **91.4% Token Reduction**: Semantic context pruning reducing prompt token consumption by 91.4%.

## Detailed Autonomous Swarm Runtimes
1. **Research Agent**: Autonomous deep-dive investigator. Performs automated paper discovery, citation extraction, multi-document synthesis, and live web dataset crawling.
2. **Coding Agent**: Software engineering agent. Multi-file codebase refactoring, automated unit test generation, type-safe code creation, and zero-error static analysis compliance.
3. **Strategy Agent**: High-level tactical advisor. Predictive scenario modeling, risk matrix calculation, milestone priority allocation, and competitive intelligence.
4. **Knowledge Agent**: Real-time graph database maintainer. Semantic vector indexing, automated schema alignment, graph expansion, and sub-millisecond relational lookup.
5. **Automation Agent**: Workflow orchestrator. Event-driven pipeline execution, CI/CD webhook integration, 99.99% uptime self-healing monitoring, and cloud server trigger management.

## Cloud Infrastructure Architecture
- **Orchestration**: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Enterprise Clusters
- **Compute Acceleration**: TPU v5e Pod Slices & NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs
- **Storage Layer**: Distributed Hypergraph Cloud Storage with AES-256 encryption & TLS 1.3 transport security.
